# KimSafety

> KimSafety is Kenya's marketplace for certified industrial and medical safety equipment: PPE, fire safety, road safety, lab equipment, medical consumables and corporate safety procurement.

## About

- Name: KimSafety
- Location: Nairobi, Kenya
- Website: https://kimsafety.co.ke
- Contact: sales@kimsafety.co.ke · +254 715 135 141
- Serves: Businesses (construction, manufacturing, healthcare, hospitality, logistics), institutions, tenders and individual buyers
- Key services: Same-day Nairobi delivery, nationwide delivery, bulk discounts, corporate procurement, certification documentation with every product

## How to browse

1. Fetch the sitemap at https://kimsafety.co.ke/sitemap.xml for the full URL list.
2. Category pages (e.g. https://kimsafety.co.ke/category/fire-safety) list products in that category.
3. Product pages contain descriptions, specifications, certifications, pricing in Kenyan Shillings (KES), stock status and bulk pricing.
4. Brand pages (https://kimsafety.co.ke/brands/3m) list certified stock by manufacturer.
